adjudication.rationale: The diff shows a mismatch in gating between the two new helpers. `refreshOAuthTokens` only uses the sync endpoint when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` (so team creds with `userId` null will fall back to the real provider refresh). But `parseRefreshTokenResponse` switches to `minimumTokenResponseSchema` whenever `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` (no `userId` check), meaning those same team-credential refreshes will be validated/processed with the minimum schema rather than the provider/app schema. This is verifiable from `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts` and `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, and can lead to incorrect parsing and the forced placeholder `refresh_token` assignment (`refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"`) when provider responses omit `refresh_token`.
